ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the lateral lobes and 40% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central wedge and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the primary surface of the left and right lobes. These are separated by a central low-intensity black 'V' shaped wedge. Black mottling and stippling are visible along the ventral-medial transition zones. A single distinct low-intensity circular spot is located in the upper-mid region of the right lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees; notch depth extends approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with continuous small-scale serrations. Notable high-amplitude peaks and valleys are present on the inner margins of both lobes near the median notch. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits more frequent micro-serrations than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch, while the overall lobe shape displays a convex outer curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixel aggregates are visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating localized surface encrustation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertically-oriented, parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the central black region, particularly prominent near the base of the fluke and the trailing edge of the central wedge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake marks on the central dark region and significant jagged irregularities/tears along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast black circular focal point is located within the white field of the right lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the trailing edge to the leading edge.
